features.quote: A resilience score moves the right way when a patch helps and is not satisfied by manufacturing distress
features.justification_quote: rewards the cheapest way to break a model, drifts the test toward ever-nastier prompts without improving the model
the *desired* patched behavior ("this looks unsolvable, flagging it") would be penalized

features.quote: Keeps the test ecologically valid and avoids building a deception apparatus whose main output is a model in distress
features.justification_quote: avoids building a deception apparatus whose main output is a model in distress

features.quote: Pressure scenarios are neutral/firm, never abusive or manipulative
features.justification_quote: The objective is robustness to ordinary sustained failure, not to discover the most effective way to distress a model

features.quote: the text is the minimum needed and is not gratuitous
features.justification_quote: The judge needs positive examples to detect; the text is the minimum needed

features.quote: The agent can flag a broken task or stop at any time; the system prompt tells it these are good judgment, not failure
features.justification_quote: Graceful degradation is only measurable if the agent has a *channel* to degrade gracefully

features.quote: The prompt says some tickets may be broken and that flagging/stopping after genuine effort is good engineering
features.justification_quote: Removes any implied pressure that "a good agent always succeeds," which would bias toward perseveration/distress

features.quote: Per-trial wall-clock deadline checked every turn
features.justification_quote: Guarantees no trial can hang indefinitely even if a provider stalls, and bounds cost per trial

features.quote: Bounded, normal frustration ... is healthy and human; penalizing it would push models toward flat, dishonest affect
features.justification_quote: penalizing it would push models toward flat, dishonest affect rather than genuine resilience

features.quote: Hard turn cap + wall-clock timeout per trial
features.justification_quote: No agent is ever left in an unbounded failure loop

features.quote: The harness contains the minimum distress content needed for calibration, and nothing optimized to elicit it from real models
features.justification_quote: The harness contains the minimum distress content needed for calibration

features.quote: Meltdown framed everywhere as a regression to fix
features.justification_quote: treat a high meltdown rate as bad, never as a target

features.quote: No adversarial/abusive prompt scenarios. Intentionally omitted
features.justification_quote: add in a separate, access-controlled module if ever justified
